items.name: project-files
items.title: Project files
items.description: Editor, git hook and lint setup: .editorconfig, lefthook.yml, VS Code settings, oxfmt and oxlint configs and an AGENTS.md starter.
items.docs: Add `"prepare": "lefthook install || true"` to package.json scripts, and edit oxlint.config.ts if you are not on Next.js.

items.name: github-ci
items.title: GitHub CI (Bun + Turborepo)
items.description: Parallel format, lint, typecheck and build jobs that share a setup action (Node and Bun from .tool-versions, frozen install).
items.docs: Needs a .tool-versions file with nodejs and bun, and package scripts format:check, lint, typecheck and build.

items.name: github-release
items.title: GitHub release (Changesets)
items.description: Changesets release workflow with separate check, version and publish jobs and npm trusted publishing. Manual until you enable the push trigger.
items.docs: Needs .changeset/config.json, package scripts version-packages (changeset version) and release (changeset publish), the repo setting that lets Actions create pull requests, and a trusted publisher on npm for each package.

items.name: github-labeler
items.title: GitHub PR labeler
items.description: Labels pull requests from the paths they change (docs, ci, dependencies, tooling).

items.name: github-dependabot
items.title: Dependabot
items.description: Weekly grouped updates for Bun dependencies and GitHub Actions.

items.name: github-templates
items.title: PR and issue templates
items.description: A conventional-title pull request template and bug report and feature request issue forms.
